items.description: Exterior door, white, single leaf, closed, with full glass pane (one large light), black lever handle and hinges, white trim
items.location: centre, middle, behind the dining table
items.beyond: Glass shows deck with white railing, distant houses, plains and hazy mountains under pale sky

items.description: Tall white double-hung window with two sashes (upper and lower panes), dark roller shade partly lowered at top
items.location: left, middle, left of the door
items.beyond: Sky, dry grass field/hillside, white deck railing, distant horizon

items.description: Tall white-framed windows stacked with transom panes, multiple panes, in the adjacent raised area
items.location: right, top to middle, behind the plant

items.description: Large black wooden-bead chandelier with draped strands, a rope-wrapped top ring, and visible bulbs; one fixture
items.location: top left, hanging over the table

items.description: Rectangular light-wood dining table with thick block legs
Dark burgundy/plum velvet curved-back dining chairs with thin black legs; about 4 in front, 1 more partly visible at far left
Cream upholstered chair/bench back visible behind the table at the far end
White round pedestal bowl with moss-like filler as table centrepiece
Tall artificial rubber-plant in a white planter with gold legs/stand
Black and white striped area rug under the table
Small black wire plant stand or side table
White baseboard trim along the wall; light wood flooring

edges: Left: the window, the table end and a chair are cut off. Right: the raised windows, plant and planter are cut off. Top: the chandelier and ceiling are cut off. Bottom: the chairs, rug and floor are cut off.
